capabilities: : Generate flashcards from notes or selections
: Review and edit generated cards before saving
: Sync folder content for batch card generation
: Maintain Spaced Repetition review history across regenerations
extras: Free tier covers single notes (up to 10 cards) with own AI key or Ollama. Pro is $3/month and adds folder generation, synced folders, and hosted generation.
problem: Manually creating flashcards from extensive notes is time-consuming and inefficient.

relations.evidence: Export a note's cards, including ones you wrote by hand, to an Anki import file.
Cards are written in the format used by the Spaced Repetition plugin, so you keep reviewing in Obsidian exactly as you do now.

summary: A tool that uses AI to generate spaced-repetition flashcards from selected notes, allowing review before saving and exporting to Anki.
